audience: vacation rental owners and property managers who run bookings in OwnerRez

useCases.title: See upcoming arrivals and booking details
useCases.text: The AI lists bookings and opens one to read its details. You get a view of who arrives soon and at which property.

useCases.title: Review guest inquiries and messages
useCases.text: The AI lists pre-booking inquiries with the property for each and reads messages from guest threads. It sums up what guests ask.

useCases.title: Check recent payments and quotes
useCases.text: The AI lists payments with amounts and dates and lists quotes. It helps you match what was paid with what was offered.

useCases.title: Create quotes or bookings and add or update guests
useCases.text: The AI creates a quote for a property and date range, or a booking. It can also add a new guest or update a guest first.

useCases.title: Update a booking or reply in a guest thread
useCases.text: The AI changes an existing booking, or posts a message into a guest-communication thread.
